shared_elements: head or headdress above a decorated torso
arms or side appendages alongside the body
circular/disc motifs on the body or costume

justification: Both show a single central anthropomorphic being with a head/headdress, torso ornament, side appendages, and circular or band-like motifs placed on the body. The biggest difference is that A is a simplified frontal block-like figure dominated by torso features, while B is an elaborate standing personage with feathered headdress, staff-like/object details, glyphic panels, and a pedestal-like lower register.
